slot.brief: Fill the blank in an everyday sentence with the correct phrasal verb (e.g., 'call off / call up / call for') based on context meaning.

stem: The organisers had to ______ the outdoor concert because of the heavy rain.

verdicts.working: “Put off” means postpone, which fits cancelling or delaying the concert due to heavy rain.

working:
“Put off” means postpone, which fits the cancellation of the concert due to rain.

Independent check: “Put off” means postpone, which fits cancelling or delaying the concert due to heavy rain.
solution: “Put off” means to postpone, which fits delaying the outdoor concert because of heavy rain.
